description: Convert a Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds, or a date and time text, into a Unix timestamp, ISO 8601, RFC 2822 and UTC forms. offset sets the zone of the answer. The answer says what the input was read as. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

offset.description: UTC offset as a sign and four digits, from -1200 to +1200, for example +0200 or -0530.

value.description: A Unix timestamp, or a date and time text such as 2026-09-30 14:00.

name: convert_timestamp
title: Convert a timestamp or date
